instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Outdoors on a sunny concrete plaza, two friends play. In the right foreground, the woman with long light brown hair (R6) balances on one leg with her arms outstretched, smiling as she moves. She wears a dark sheer top and light blue jeans. In the left background, the woman with curly dark hair (R5) squats down in a dark sheer top and tan pants, smiling as she watches her friend. Bright, direct sunlight fills the scene, creating a high-key, energetic atmosphere against a clear sky.
